name: White House
description: Follow White House, a tracked organization, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Why did Army Secretary Dan Driscoll resign?
changes.summary: The White House has confirmed that Army Secretary Dan Driscoll is resigning. The move comes after months of friction between him and Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. Marine veteran and former CIA officer Elliot Ackerman joins with analysis.

changes.title: Army Secretary Dan Driscoll resigning after friction with Hegseth
changes.summary: Army Secretary Dan Driscoll is resigning, the White House confirmed.

changes.title: U.S.-Venezuela oil deal will rely on North American Blue Energy Partners
changes.summary: The Trump administration's plan to take a stake in tens of billions of barrels of Venezuelan oil reserves will hinge on a private company called North American Blue Energy Partners, the White House announced Monday.

changes.title: SCOTUS Green Lights Trump Ballroom; Army Secretary to Resign
changes.summary: Secretary of the Army, Dan Driscoll, is expected to step down after repeated clashes with Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth over the war in Iran, the direction of the military and national security. changes.title: Army Secretary Dan Driscoll is stepping down after 18 months on the job, White House says
changes.summary: No reason was given for the departure of Driscoll, who is a friend of Vice President JD Vance, but tensions with Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth have been widely reported.

changes.title: Army Secretary Dan Driscoll is stepping down, White House says
changes.summary: Army Secretary Dan Driscoll is stepping down after 18 months on the job, the White House said Monday, in the latest departure of a top military leader during the Trump administration. (Image credit: Karl B. DeBlaker).

changes.title: Days after Trump announces Venezuela oil deal, White House fills in some of the details
changes.summary: As part of the deal, the U.S. is creating a private company as a joint venture with North American Blue Energy Partners, owned by Venezuelan businessman Alejandro Betancourt. (Image credit: Matias Delacroix).

changes.title: Supreme Court continues to allow construction of Trump's White House ballroom
changes.summary: The Supreme Court divided 5-4 in allowing construction of the new White House ballroom to continue.

changes.title: Venezuela grants U.S.-backed oil firm NABEP 100-year concessions for 17 oil fields, White House says
changes.summary: Venezuelan interim authorities have granted North American Blue Energy Partners 100-year concessions for 17 oil fields, White House says.
